rules.impact: The backend cannot confirm and register the requested managed memory capacity.
rules.evidence_method: On A3, scan with the official mem_scan.py at 1 GB and 2 MB granularity. On A2, read HugePages_Total, HugePages_Free, HugePages_Rsvd, and Hugepagesize, then compare unreserved static huge-page capacity (Free - Rsvd) with the target.

remediation.description: Restore scan capability or release memory according to the check details, then rerun the check.

rules.impact: Required pooled-memory semantic features are unavailable, so KV Pool cannot be used.
rules.evidence_method: Read CANN Toolkit installation information and ASCEND_TOOLKIT_HOME inside the container.

remediation.description: Rebuild or update the image with a CANN 9.1.0 or newer offline package matching the hardware, image, and operating system, then rerun the check.

rules.problem: HDK version does not meet the requirement for the current hardware and backend
rules.impact: The HDK version is lower than the minimum required by the current hardware and backend, which may reduce managed-memory availability or prevent KV Pool initialization.
rules.evidence_method: Read the npu-smi and driver version.info files visible in the container, and select the minimum HDK version from the hardware/backend pair. Mooncake software dependencies are evaluated by a separate scenario.

remediation.description: Upgrade host HDK to the minimum version in the check details. Refresh the Docker mounts, restart the container, and rerun the check.

rules.problem: Linux kernel version is lower than 6.6.0
rules.impact: KV Pool may fail in multi-node deployments. Single-node deployments are not affected by this dependency.
rules.evidence_method: Run uname -r inside the container to read the host Linux kernel version visible to the container.

remediation.description: Upgrade the host Linux kernel to 6.6.0 or newer through the host maintenance process. Rebuild or restart the container and rerun the check.

rules.problem: L1 1520 Lingqu CC version requires manual confirmation of 1.5.0 or newer
rules.impact: A3 with memcache or mooncake may fail to establish links, making KV Pool unavailable.

parameters.required_confirmation: The version cannot be detected automatically. Log in to the L1 1520 switch or use the BMC managed-device interface to confirm that the version meets the requirement.

rules.evidence_method: The version cannot be detected automatically. Log in to the L1 1520 switch or use the BMC managed-device interface to confirm that the version meets the requirement.

remediation.description: Log in to the L1 1520 switch and the BMC managed-device interface to check the Lingqu CC version. If it is lower than 1.5.0, ask the network device administrator to upgrade it.

rules.problem: Intra-node SIO/HCCS links on A3 are not ready
rules.impact: Basic die-to-die interconnect inside the A3 node is unavailable.

positioning.target: Static intra-chip SIO and cross-chip HCCS topology and link state
positioning.coverage: All visible A3 cards and dies on the current host

rules.evidence_method: Enumerate all visible A3 cards and dies, and check SIO/HCCS topology, health, lane completeness, and link speed.

remediation.description: Use the failed card, die, and lane details to inspect the corresponding SIO/HCCS physical link, then rerun the check after repair.

rules.problem: Intra-node cross-chip communication on A3 is abnormal
rules.impact: HCCL data exchange inside the A3 node is unreliable.

positioning.target: Dynamic HCCL data paths across all visible dies
positioning.coverage: All visible A3 dies on the current host

rules.evidence_method: When static links are healthy and all NPUs are idle, start one HCCL rank for each visible die, run an all-to-all data-correctness test, and compare HCCS retry/error counter deltas from the test window.

remediation.description: Use the failed ranks or newly incremented retry/error counters to locate the HCCL data path, then rerun the check after repair.

rules.problem: NPU RoCE port is not ready
rules.impact: The corresponding NPU RoCE port is unavailable.

positioning.target: Static readiness of each NPU port
positioning.coverage: All visible NPUs on the current host

rules.evidence_method: Use hccn_tool on each NPU to read the IP address, netmask, Link state, net health, and MTU. Check IP uniqueness and netmask/MTU consistency without sending test traffic.

remediation.description: Use the failed NPU details to inspect the IP address, netmask, Link state, net health, and MTU, then rerun the check after restoring static port readiness.

rules.problem: Local NPU-to-NPU RoCE data path is abnormal
rules.impact: RoCE data transfer between NPUs on the current host is unreliable.

positioning.target: Dynamic local NPU-to-NPU RoCE data paths
positioning.coverage: All N*(N-1) directed NPU pairs on the current host

rules.evidence_method: When static ports are ready, run N*(N-1) directed hccn_tool ping checks across all visible NPUs. Check packet loss and deltas for FCS, RoCE, checksum, and QP error counters from the current test window.

remediation.description: Use the failed directed pairs or newly incremented error counters to inspect the source and destination NPUs, switch ports, VLAN/PFC settings, and HCCN configuration. Rerun the full local matrix after repair.

rules.problem: Docker does not expose the Ascend devices, driver, or HCCN entry point
rules.impact: The container cannot access the NPU, driver, or an available HCCN entry point, so KV Pool cannot initialize correctly.
rules.evidence_method: Check the Docker marker, npu-smi, /dev/davinci*, /usr/local/Ascend/driver, and confirm that at least one of /etc/hccn.conf or an executable hccn_tool is available.

remediation.description: Recreate the container with Ascend devices and driver directories exposed. Mount /etc/hccn.conf or ensure hccn_tool is executable, then rerun the check.

rules.problem: mooncake-transfer-engine-npu is unavailable or does not meet the requirement for the current HDK
rules.impact: Mooncake backend software dependencies are not satisfied, so KV Pool cannot run reliably.
rules.evidence_method: Read the mooncake-transfer-engine-npu version from Python package metadata and apply the A3 HDK-dependent minimum version.

remediation.description: Install mooncake-transfer-engine-npu. A3 with HDK 26.0.0 or newer has no minimum package version; A2 and A3 with HDK 25.5.0 require 0.3.11.post1 or newer.

rules.impact: Mooncake wheel runtime dependencies are not satisfied, so the backend cannot load correctly.
rules.evidence_method: Parse the glibc version from ldd --version inside the container.

remediation.description: Rebuild the runtime image from a base image with glibc 2.35 or newer, then rerun the check.

rules.impact: The Memcache backend is missing a required dependency, so KV Pool cannot run correctly.
rules.evidence_method: Confirm through Python package metadata that memfabric-hybrid is installed.

remediation.description: Bake the memfabric-hybrid offline package into the image, recreate the container, and rerun the check.

rules.impact: The Memcache backend is missing a required dependency, so KV Pool cannot run correctly.
rules.evidence_method: Confirm through Python package metadata that memcache-hybrid is installed.

remediation.description: Bake the memcache-hybrid offline package into the image, recreate the container, and rerun the check.

rules.problem: memcache-hybrid is not installed or is lower than 1.2.0
rules.impact: SSD cache dependencies are not satisfied, so Memcache SSD Offload cannot work correctly.
rules.evidence_method: Read the memcache-hybrid version from Python package metadata.

remediation.description: Upgrade memcache-hybrid to 1.2.0 or newer and bake it into the image, then recreate the container and rerun the check.

rules.problem: SSD Offload storage requirements are not satisfied
rules.evidence_method: Check --ssd-path according to the storage policy for the current backend.

remediation.description: Prepare the SSD path required by the current backend according to the check details, then rerun the check.
